gloss: communication power; ability to spread a message

definitions.gloss: communication power; ability to influence through messaging
definitions.explanation: The ability to effectively communicate and spread one's message or ideas, especially through media or social platforms.

examples.japanese: {発信力|はっしんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧。
SNS⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{発信力|はっしんりょく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{大|おお}きい→大きい：00335_ookii⟧。
examples.english: The communication power of social media is great.

examples.japanese: ⟦この→この：00962_kono⟧⟦{地域|ちいき}→地域：01461_chiiki⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{魅力|みりょく}→魅力：03749_miryoku⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧{発信力|はっしんりょく}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{伝|つた}えて→伝える：01220_tsutaeru⟧⟦もらいたい→もらう：00520_morau⟧。
examples.english: I want someone with strong communication skills to convey the appeal of this area.

notes: A modern compound: ⟦{発信|はっしん}→発信：04895_hasshin⟧ (transmission, broadcasting) + {力|りょく} (power, ability). Became widely used with the rise of social media and personal branding. Part of a series of 〜{力|りょく} compounds: ⟦{影響力|えいきょうりょく}→影響力：20040_eikyouryoku⟧ (influence), ⟦{表現力|ひょうげんりょく}→表現力：21315_hyougenryoku⟧ (expressive power), ⟦{訴求力|そきゅうりょく}→訴求力：22082_sokyuuryoku⟧ (appeal). Collocations: {発信力|はっしんりょく}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{高|たか}める→高める：02065_takameru⟧ (strengthen communication power), {発信力|はっしんりょく}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦ある→ある：00006_aru⟧ (to have strong outreach ability).
